item.title: GitHub Actions Runner Controller 0.15.0 Targets Reliability at Scale
item.description: GitHub has released Actions Runner Controller (ARC) 0.15.0, introducing reliability, scalability, and observability improvements for organisations running self-hosted GitHub Actions runners on Kubernetes. By Craig Risi (1 source: infoq)

item.title: Beyond synthetic testing: Capturing and replaying real database workloads at Airbnb
Stop paging on how your machines feel
item.description: Many companies are frustrated that their customers find outages before their monitoring does. The problem is usually that they're paging on infrastructure metrics like CPU and disk, because those are easy to measure. (1 source: sreweekly)
